name: PromptInput
usage: The message field of an AI chat, prompts with attachments, any field that sends with Enter

props.name: value
props.description: The text (controlled). Clear it yourself in `onSubmit`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial text (uncontrolled); the text is cleared after each submission.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the text changes.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description:
Called with the text and the files when `Enter` or the send button is pressed. Not called while
`generating`, while disabled, or when there is neither text nor a file.

props.name: generating
props.description:
A reply is being generated: the send button turns into "Stop generating" (`onStop`, also on `Esc`) and
`Enter` does not submit. Typing is still possible.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the stop button or `Esc` is pressed while `generating`.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder; "Type a message" by default.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the text field; "Message" by default.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables typing, attaching and sending.

props.name: disabledReason
props.description:
Disabled reason, shown on hover or keyboard focus while `disabled` (as on Button). With a reason, the text field
can still be focused (`aria-disabled`, read-only) and screen readers read the reason.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Maximum number of visible lines; longer text scrolls inside the field.

props.name: allowFiles
props.description: Allows attaching files: the attach button, dropping files on the field and pasting files.

props.name: files
props.description: The attached files (controlled).

props.name: defaultFiles
props.description: Initial files (uncontrolled); the files are cleared after each submission.

props.name: onFilesChange
props.description: Called when files are added or removed.

props.name: accept
props.description:
Accepted file types: comma-separated extensions and MIME types, such as `".pdf,image/*"` (as on Upload).
Every type is accepted by default.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Maximum size of one file in bytes. No limit by default; the server must check it as well.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Maximum number of attached files.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called for each file that was not attached, with the reason.

props.name: actions
props.description: Your own controls in the bottom bar, before the send button, such as a model picker.

types.name: PromptInputSubmit
types.summary: What PromptInput submits: the text (without leading and trailing whitespace) and the attached files.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The text without leading and trailing whitespace; may be empty when only files are attached.

fields.name: files
fields.description: The attached files, in the order they were added. The component has not read or uploaded them.

types.name: PromptInputRejectReason
types.summary:
Why a file was not attached: `type` does not match `accept`, `size` exceeds `maxSize`, `count` would exceed
`maxFiles`.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
`Enter` sends and `Shift+Enter` adds a line break; the field grows with the text. The text is cleared after
sending (uncontrolled).

examples.name: Attachments
examples.title: Attachments
examples.description:
With `allowFiles`, files can be chosen with the paperclip, dropped on the field or pasted. `accept`, `maxSize`
and `maxFiles` limit them; rejected files go to `onReject`. The files are handed to `onSubmit` with the text,
and the component never reads or uploads them.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.title: Disabled
examples.description:
`disabledReason` explains why nothing can be sent; the field stays focusable and shows the reason on hover or
focus.

examples.name: Conversation
examples.title: A small conversation
examples.description:
PromptInput with MessageList and useStream (a simulated endpoint): send a message, watch the reply stream, stop it
with the stop button or `Esc`. The suggestions in the empty state send their label.
